description: This Java source file defines the TransportClient class used in Apache Spark for managing network communication, including fetching data chunks, streaming, sending RPCs, and handling connection state.

classes.name: TransportClient
classes.description: A thread-safe client class for managing network communication with a remote server, including data chunk fetching, streaming, RPC, and connection management.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Returns the Netty channel associated with this client.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the client connection is active and not timed out.

methods.name: getSocketAddress
methods.description: Returns the remote socket address of the connection.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID used for authentication, if set.

methods.name: setClientId
methods.description: Sets the client ID for authentication; can only be set once.

methods.name: fetchChunk
methods.description: Requests a specific data chunk from the server for a given stream ID and chunk index.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Requests to stream data from the server for a specified stream ID.

methods.name: sendRpc
methods.description: Sends an RPC message to the server and returns a request ID.

methods.name: sendMergedBlockMetaReq
methods.description: Sends a request to fetch merged block metadata from the server.

methods.name: uploadStream
methods.description: Streams data to the server with associated metadata and handles the reply.

methods.name: sendRpcSync
methods.description: Sends an RPC message synchronously, waiting for a response within a timeout.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an opaque message to the server without expecting a reply.

methods.name: removeRpcRequest
methods.description: Removes the state associated with a specific RPC request ID.

methods.name: timeOut
methods.description: Marks the client connection as timed out.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Returns the TransportResponseHandler associated with this client.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the network channel and marks the client as timed out.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the TransportClient.
